explanation_full: Based on the descriptive statistics, Ethanol showed the highest mean value (0.4736) and the largest standard deviation (0.2528) compared to other features. Acetate followed closely with a mean of 0.4465 and a standard deviation of 0.226. Butyrate also displayed a high mean (0.4287) and a substantial standard deviation (0.2474). Conversely, pH had the lowest mean (0.2355) and the smallest standard deviation (0.1267). These findings highlight the variability and central tendency of key metabolic features in the dataset.
